subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should the three new optional GetReplyOptions progress-lifecycle fields become the supported public Plugin SDK contract for channel-owned progress drafts?
rationale: The behavior fix is plausible and additive, but repository policy requires maintainer intent for a new public plugin seam because future plugins may depend on its lifecycle semantics.

options.title: Accept the channel-owned seam
options.body: Keep the three optional fields, document their lifecycle contract, resolve the merge conflicts, and rerun exact-head API-boundary and behavior proof before landing.

options.title: Keep the seam internal
options.body: Replace the public GetReplyOptions additions with an internal runtime contract while retaining the time-gate and compositor behavior.

options.title: Pause the broader headline work
options.body: Land only the narrow time-gate regression fix and revisit preamble headlines and narrator lifecycle as separately sponsored work.

recommendation.title: Accept the channel-owned seam
recommendation.body: Keep the three optional fields, document their lifecycle contract, resolve the merge conflicts, and rerun exact-head API-boundary and behavior proof before landing.
